title: City Office REIT Announces Dividends for Third Quarter 2024
description: City Office REIT, Inc. announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a quarterly dividend for the third quarter of 2024 for its common stock and preferred stock.

title: City Office REIT Announces Dividends for Fourth Quarter 2024
description: City Office REIT announced a quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share of common stock and common unit of partnership interest for the fourth quarter of 2024, as well as a regular quarterly dividend of $0.4140625 per share of the company's 6.625% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock.
